Ajay Kumar Maikhuri and others ………Petitioners
Vs.
Dilip Jawalkar and others ………Respondents
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. K.K. Joshi, learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. This contempt petition has been filed under Section 12 
of The Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 alleging willful and 
deliberate contempt of Co-ordinate Bench’s order dated 
11.12.2025, passed in WPSS No.624 of 2023, Ajay Kumar 
Maikhuri and others Vs. State of Uttarakhand and others, 
whereby the petitioners were given liberty to move 
representation to Secretary (Finance) within a period of two 
weeks from the date of this order, and if such a 
representation is filed by the petitioners the Secretary 
(Finance) was directed to take a decision on the 
representation of the petitioners within four months from 
the date of filing of the representation.
3. Misc. Application (IA No.1 of 2026) is allowed. 
Additional affidavit containing the representation of 
petitioner nos.2 to 11 filed by the petitioner is taken on 
record.
4. Though copy of the order dated 11.12.2025 was served 
upon all four respondents-contemnors, but in the order 
dated 11.12.2025 the Secretary (Finance) was directed to 
decide the same.
5. The copy of the order was served upon Secretary 
(Finance) on 17.12.2025, but despite order the compliance 
has not been made so far. 2
6. Issue notice to the respondent-contemnor no.1
returnable within six weeks.
7. Steps to be taken within three days.
8. List this case on 23.09.2026.
9. In the meantime, respondent-contemnor no.1 may file 
response or comply with the order. 
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 20.07.2026
SK
